mainEntity.name: What factors determine the cost of an interior demolition project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior demolition costs depend on the square footage, material density, ease of access, and disposal fees. Removing light drywall partitions and carpet is substantially less labor-intensive than breaking out concrete hearths, plaster walls, or glued-down hardwood floors. Hazardous material considerations, such as handling older paint or insulation materials, also alter pricing. Site access plays a major role: carrying debris down multiple flights of stairs or across finished living spaces increases labor hours compared to rolling roll-off bins directly adjacent to a ground-floor staging door.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs depend on square footage, material types, disposal requirements, and site accessibility, such as carrying debris through finished rooms versus using direct dumpster access.
